title: Constant-Parameter Quantum Locally Testable Codes
exact_target: Can quantum locally testable codes simultaneously have positive constant rate, relative distance, and soundness while every test acts on only a constant number of qubits?

sources.citation: Error Correction Zoo, Quantum locally testable code (QLTC), maintained through 2026, accessed 2026-08-22.
Andrew Cross, Zhiyang He, Anand Natarajan, Mario Szegedy, and Guanyu Zhu, Quantum Locally Testable Code with Constant Soundness, arXiv:2209.11405v3 (2024), Section 2, Definition 2.4.
